# Tools overview (generated)

> Generated by `npm run docs:generate:tools` from the registered tool definitions. Do not edit by hand.
> Surface: config keys: 57 · sections: 16 · tools: 21 · baseline 2026-11-12. Generated from `scripts/surface-baseline.json`; do not edit by hand.

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `tower_batch` | Manage finite evidence batches: create freezes missionIds/requiredChecks/receiptPaths, status summarizes members, close verifies every required check and receipt hash, abandon retires a stale open batch. Membership and exclusions are immutable after create; close/abandon never remove missions. |
| `tower_complete` | Worker-only: report mission completion. Requires every task done or dropped, no blockers, the current owner, at least one commit (survey/sandbox use their recorded commit), and no unread inbox. checks records evidence; result is survey-only. The report is capped by gates.maxReportBytes. |
| `tower_finding` | Report (op: report), list/read (op: list, default) or update (op: update) findings. report needs type bug|improve|vuln|idea, title, summary, details, suggested_fix; update needs id plus status/note. Use for anything outside your mission scope. Details: docs/reference/tools.md. |
| `tower_import` | Import a legacy Tower/DSH state file read-only (op: snapshot, needs sourcePath) or record/serve audit-only legacy mission mappings (op: map, default). Never activates, adopts or resumes paused missions. Tower-only. Details: docs/reference/tools.md. |
| `tower_inbox` | Read your tower inbox: messages addressed to you plus broadcasts, newest first. Only returned messages are acknowledged; the result reports unreadRemaining, so keep reading until it reaches 0. Set include_read for history. Unread messages block tower_complete. |
| `tower_init` | Initialize Tower state under <git-common-dir>/dsh-tower for the repository at absolute repoRoot (op: init, default), or reconcile the roster with the durable subagent catalog after a restart (op: adopt). Only the tower may init or adopt. Details: docs/reference/tools.md. |
| `tower_inspect` | Read-only Tower views: status (dashboard or one mission), roster (live agent activity), diff (mission branch patch), preflight (merge gate blockers and warnings), doctor (environment health). missionId selects a mission for diff/preflight. Never writes state or git. |
| `tower_interrupt` | Interrupt one running tower roster agent (worker or reviewer) and record it as interrupted in the roster. Only the tower may interrupt. Idempotent: an agent that is not running returns interrupted:false. Use it before takeover after a runaway worker, or to stop work that is no longer wanted. |
| `tower_merge` | Merge a mission branch into the recorded base with --no-ff after the gate passes, or reconcile an already-landed merge. A failed gate returns blocker codes; hook failures and content conflicts are reported separately. Tower-only. |
| `tower_mission` | Update one mission: lifecycle status, decision note, blocker, clear blockers, mark a task done, drop a task with a reason, or widen the scope (tower only). "merged" is never set here; only a future tower_merge records it. Merged and abandoned are terminal. |
| `tower_mode` | Read the calling session's Tower mode (omit active), or enter (active true), leave (active false), or take over repository ownership (active "takeover", needs authorization). Writes require mode.allowAgentControl. Details: docs/reference/tools.md. |
| `tower_plan` | Plan missions in an initialized repository: title (printable Unicode, at most 120 chars), relative scope globs, optional tasks, deps, and kind build|survey. Assigns M1.. ids, serializes overlapping build scopes, rejects cycles, and warns when a survey dependency is stale. |
| `tower_rebase` | Rebase a mission branch onto the current base tip in its own worktree. Refuses while a worker runs or the worktree is dirty. A clean rebase waives re-review; a conflict aborts and blocks the mission; a branch already in the base returns alreadyMerged. |
| `tower_recover` | Recovery diagnostics and stale state-lock repair. status reports the lock owner with age, heartbeat, and staleness; clear-stale-lock needs confirm:CLEAR_STALE_LOCK and only moves a lock whose PID is dead (force also clears a live-but-silent PID) to a backup. Never resets state. |
| `tower_reload` | Dev-only: ask DSH HMR to reload the Tower Host plugin from disk. Registered only while tower-hmr is on (shipped off). Fails with reload-unavailable without HMR. Details: docs/reference/tools.md. |
| `tower_resource` | Advisory resource leases per repository (coordination only; no OS CPU/memory hard cap). acquire/release require a token and are tower-only; status is read-only. Expired leases are never taken over silently. |
| `tower_review` | Submit a review verdict bound to the current tip: status clean|p1-N|p2-N, merge merge|fix-then-merge|hold. Non-clean returns the mission to active; only clean + merge approves. Reviewers are capped per branch; breakGlassReason is tower-only. Unregistered when review.mode is off. |
| `tower_send` | Send a durable inbox message to a tower participant: a roster agent name, "tower", or "all" (broadcast). The message is persisted first; when the recipient is a currently running roster agent the tower also steers it into that child's current turn. Returns delivery results. |
| `tower_spawn` | Spawn a worker, survey, or reviewer for a mission. A build provisions (or reuses) the mission worktree; surveys read one recorded commit; a reviewer needs a completed mission and the read-only preset. Returns when the agent is recorded, unless wait=true. Details: docs/reference/tools.md. |
| `tower_teardown` | Remove eligible merged/abandoned mission worktrees. A running agent is always kept; dirty worktrees need force; exclude skips named missions; dry_run previews. Due terminal missions are archived under dsh-tower/archive, never deleted. |
| `tower_test` | Run the mission worktree's declared tower.testDiscovery (package.json) and record the receipt. Returns ok:false with diagnostics when discovery fails; does not change mission status. Use tower_complete for automatic admission checks. |
